brief: A welcoming identity for everyday Nigerians seeking clear explanations and traceable constitutional sources.
criteria: An open C, a clear white passage and a green-and-white palette. A compact symbol for small screens; the full name for first encounters.

concepts.name: Open Clause
concepts.idea: A C opens around a white passage: constitutional knowledge made accessible, with a Nigerian flag reference.
rationale: Circular geometry feels calm and approachable.
The white split remains a real opening in every variant.
Green and white establish the Nigerian identity.
Outlined lettering works without installed fonts.

recommendation: Use the green horizontal logo on white for the main identity, white on green or dark ink, and the dedicated tile for browser tabs.
next_steps: SVG and transparent PNG artwork supplied.
Web icons and a ready-to-copy manifest supplied.
See the usage guide for clear space and minimum sizes.
Application mockups illustrate the identity; they are not implemented product screens.
